name: OligoVigil
description: 737 human curator-verified therapeutic oligonucleotide safety and off-target evidence rows (626 toxicity + 111 off-target) from 660 primary sources, with provenance, benchmark splits, and bulk downloads. AI-assisted single-curator curation (a human adjudicated v2 LLM proposals over source passages, re-curated from 2003 v1 machine pre-curated candidates; machine-only rows are labelled machine_precurated_v1). Inter-curator reliability was measured on a blinded second-curator 100-row mixed accept/reject sample (KAPPA-2): Cohen kappa_binary = 0.42 (drop-abstain, n=92) / 0.34 (collapse-abstain, n=100), raw agreement 66%.

guardrails: Use verified release evidence for claims.
Treat candidate rows as non-citable gap-finding context.
Open /api/evidence_detail before making record-level safety claims.
Do not claim de novo clinical safety or sequence-specific off-target prediction.
